# A relative periodic orbit of the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation u_t = -u u_x - u_xx - u_xxxx on
# [0, L), L = 22, Galerkin truncated at 16 Fourier modes, converged by multiple shooting with
# NKSearch.jl and RK8, with closure 1e-14. Its period is T = 32.79688563412746 and it closes up
# to the translation by l = 10.958264212631029, u(x, T) = u(x - l, 0).

# The 32 degrees of freedom of u at t = 0 in KS.jl, Re U_1, Im U_1, ..., Re U_16, Im U_16, with
# u(x)/q = sum of U_k exp(ikqx) over 0 < |k| <= 16, q = 2π/L and U_-k the conjugate of U_k.
